gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: Tests for {@link JacksonInject.Value}, the helper class that carries the configuration (id, useInput, optional) backing a {@code @JacksonInject} annotation. The
ADDED i3: non-"true" text parses to FALSE
ADDED i4: useInput is null, so the supplied default (false) is returned.
ADDED i5: useInput is TRUE, so the default (false) is ignored.
ADDED i9: An empty-string id is normalized to null, so hasId() is false.
